entities.name: Theodore Ayrault Dodge
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodore Ayrault Dodge was an American officer, military historian, and businessman. He fought as a Union officer in the American Civil War; as a writer, he was devoted to both the Civil War and the great generals of ancient and European history.
